**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** expressly preserves both parties' freedom to enter similar agreements with others, which is the outcome our playbook seeks.
- Targeted searches for competing-product, field-of-use, territory, and "shall not develop/market/sell" language returned nothing binding Bluefly.
- The only Customer-side prohibitions are **§ 14.11 (no resale of the Services)** and the licence-scope limits in **§§ 12.1 and 14.17** — these govern use and redistribution of IBM's own Services and IP, not our ability to operate other businesses or buy/build alternatives, so they fall outside this rule.
- **§ 14.19** limits IBM's delivery territory (counterparty-side), not ours.
